deskyard shell: interactive login shell

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] shell

Opens an interactive bash login shell in the computer in your terminal (raw
mode, resizes follow your window). Exit with `exit` or Ctrl-D. For scripted
use, prefer exec.

Prints: the terminal session

Examples:
  deskyard -c alice shell

Where: on the chosen computer (-c COMPUTER); inside a computer without one chosen it acts locally
Exit codes: the shell's exit code; 1 when it couldn't start
